job.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
Role: Senior Test Automation Engineer
  • Join our QAEnhance Team
  • Work with clients and contribute to the test automation & orchestration design at an enterprise scale
  • Initial assignment with a highly respected NZ and Global brand
  • Hybrid Working - home + our office or on-site with client
 
About the Role
QAEnhance is a specialist quality assurance business whose mission is to orchestrate exceptional people, automation and AI to deliver better outcomes for our clients.
As we and our clients build their own AI-enabled testing capability, they are looking for a senior leader who wants to help shape the next generation of quality engineering. You will start with a major client in the logistics sector, then grow into a senior capability working across other high-profile clients.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Engaging with clients, building credibility quickly with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Understand client challenges, see the bigger picture, and recommend what to do, why, and how automation and AI can improve the outcome.
  • Build and evolve scalable automation frameworks, aligned to our clients' ways or working and deployment lifecycle.
  • Modernising current automation frameworks to Playwright and modern Microsoft and cloud-aligned tooling, while working confidently within an existing Java, Selenium and Cucumber environment.
  • Drive API automation and embed testing into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps).
  • Apply AI across the quality assurance lifecycle, from AI-assisted test generation and intelligent maintenance to test analysis and agentic approaches.
  • Challenge thinking constructively, translate technology into business outcomes, and influence quality strategy.
  • Contribute to our growing AI-enabled testing offering and wider capability.
What We're Looking For
  • 5+ years' commercial testing and automation experience, ideally at Senior or Lead level.
  • Strong coding capability and a solid understanding of automation architecture and framework design.
  • Strong Playwright capability, or the technical depth to lead a transition towards it.
  • Practical and demonstratable AI Experience - hands on and passionate about where the industry is going
  • JavaScript/TypeScript and/or strong OOP experience (Java or C#).
  • Selenium and Cucumber experience, plus BDD using Gherkin, Cucumber or SpecFlow.
  • API automation and testing capability.
  • Strong CI/CD understanding, ideally GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps.
  • Experience across regression, functional, integration, system and end-to-end testing.
  • Excellent communication and consulting skills, with a track record of advising and influencing stakeholders.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and how it can transform quality engineering.
Nice to have:
  • Microsoft technologies and Azure cloud exposure.
  • Performance testing (JMeter), mobile automation (Appium) and SQL.
  • ERP/CRM automation across SAP, Salesforce or Dynamics 365.
 
How to Apply
If you are a technically strong test automation engineer who loves leading client conversations and is excited about where AI is taking our industry, apply now. We will be in touch if you are shortlisted for this opportunity.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer - Active Directory
job.description:
Senior Security Engineer (Active Directory & Entra ID)
  • Location: Auckland (open to applicants across NZ and offshore; relocation to Auckland required)
  • Working Arrangement: Hybrid, 2 to 3 days onsite per week
Are you an enterprise Active Directory specialist with deep on-prem and Entra ID expertise? Join our client’s Identity Security squad and take ownership of a large, complex AD environment.

About the Role
Our client needs a Senior Security Engineer to secure and strengthen a highly complex enterprise Active Directory environment. You will work across on-premises AD, Domain Controllers and Entra ID, and lead security remediation across BAU and project work.
  • Manage and secure multiple AD domains, forests and Domain Controllers at enterprise scale
  • Extend and secure identity across on-prem AD and Entra ID
  • Automate administration and reporting with PowerShell
  • Join the on-call roster after six months (about one week in six, never alone)
What We’re Looking For
  • Extensive Active Directory experience in a large enterprise, covering both on-premises and cloud
  • Strong Domain Controller management expertise (20+ Domain Controllers)
  • Strong Entra ID (Azure AD) knowledge and architecture skills
  • Strong PowerShell scripting skills
  • Openness to learning new tools and languages (eg. Terraform)
Location and Relocation
We welcome applications from across New Zealand and from offshore candidates looking to relocate to New Zealand. The successful applicant must be based in Auckland, so relocation is required before starting. This role is not available as a remote-only position. It is hybrid, with 2 to 3 days onsite each week and flexibility to come in when needed.

job.title: Sales Manager
job.description:
Role: Sales Manager | Lead a Global Marine Tech Brand
  • Location: North Shore, Auckland, with national and international travel
  • Salary: Highly competitive base salary + GP-based commission + KPI bonus
  • Leadership: Lead sales and customer care across New Zealand and WASSP International
Summary: Lead a multi million dollar, high-margin marine electronics business for a Kiwi innovator trusted since 1945. Drive growth across Commercial Fishing, Government, Leisure and WASSP International, with a GP-based commission and KPI bonus that reward results.

About ENL
Recruit I.T. are proud to partner with our long-term client and partner, ENL (Electronic Navigation Limited), to find their next Sales Manager.

ENL has been equipping New Zealanders, and now the world, with the best marine electronics since 1945. Part of the global FURUNO group, ENL is New Zealand's premier marine electronics company. It designs and manufactures the WASSP multibeam sounder, sold internationally, and is the exclusive distributor of world-leading brands including FURUNO, TimeZero and Airmar.

ENL technology is trusted on everything from trailer boats and commercial fishing fleets to superyachts, seabed mapping and defence. Its team of more than 50 people combines marine expertise with business experience. ENL operates from its North Shore head office and a Nelson branch serving the Southern Hemisphere's largest fishing fleet, with a dealer network across the country. It has been ISO 9001 accredited since 2006.

About the Role
Reporting to the Managing Director and sitting on the management team, you'll lead all sales and customer care for ENL / Furuno NZ and WASSP International. You'll own and be responsible for driving all sales across the business with ambitious growth targets agreed with you. Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • Building and delivering sales plans for Commercial Fishing, Government, Leisure and WASSP International
  • Owning the relationship with FURUNO and other brand principals, including targets, forecasts and distribution terms
  • Growing the dealer, installer and boatbuilder network, and balancing channel and direct sales
  • Leading government tenders, RFPs and panel opportunities, including through GETS
  • Driving WASSP international sales through the Regional Sales Managers and distributor network, and feeding customer insight back to R&D
  • Protecting margin through pricing strategy, proposals and contract negotiation
  • Leading the sales and customer care team, including hiring a new Sales Representative
  • Reporting monthly on performance against plan, using CRM and pipeline data
Benefits
  • Competitive base salary plus a GP-based commission and KPI bonus that rewards growth and margin
  • Phone, laptop and KiwiSaver
  • A seat on the management team, with real influence over strategy
  • The chance to build your team, with headcount growing as results are achieved
  • International travel to brand principals, distributors and trade shows, plus New Zealand's leading boat shows
  • Represent game-changing technology from a NZ company competing on the global stage
Experience and Qualifications
  • 10+ years in sales, including at least 5 years in a senior sales leadership role
  • A proven track record of driving revenue and gross profit (GP) growth.
  • Experience in technical product distribution, ideally in marine electronics, marine, outdoor, automotive or electronics
  • Experience managing brand principals or suppliers, and leading dealer or reseller channels alongside direct sales
  • Experience with government tenders, RFPs or panel agreements
  • Experience leading a team across sales, and customer care
  • Strong commercial acumen across pricing, margin management and budgeting
  • International or export sales experience, a tertiary qualification and knowledge of the fishing, maritime or boating sectors are all advantageous
  • A military or defence background would be a bonus
  • A full New Zealand driver licence and the right to work in New Zealand
How to Apply
If you're a commercially driven sales leader who has a proven track record of driving sales growth and is ready to take a proud Kiwi marine brand further on the world stage, apply now with your updated CV and we will get in touch if you are shortlisted.

Candidates must have the legal right to live and work in New Zealand to be eligible for this role.
